desc: Upgrade your cleaning experience with the world's first Master Cleaning Station for rifles, handguns and shotguns. Designed for comprehensive cleaning of handguns and rifles (.22 - .45 caliber) as well as 20 & 12 ga. shotguns. It combines a Next-Gen cleaning mat with an intelligently designed cleaning kit filled with an extensive set of cleaning tools. It keeps easy-to-lose gun parts organized while you work. It provides a huge work area for a completely disassembled long gun, yet rolls up for compact storage in the included bag.
